## Install

In Foundry → **Add-on Modules → Install Module**, paste the manifest URL:

```
https://github.com/takaqiao/pf2e-xp-tool/releases/latest/download/module.json
```

## Compatibility

- Foundry VTT: minimum v12; verified v14
- PF2e system

## Changes

Remove the Foundry core upper-version installation limit. Minimum and verified versions and PF2e requirements remain unchanged.
